podcast.title: Gentlemen of the Road (2007) - Novel Title
podcast.body: Mumford & Sons named their independently created record label, Gentlemen of the Road, after Michael Chabon's 2007 novel of the same title. "They called the company Gentlemen of the Road, taking it from the title of a 2007 novel by Michael Shabon."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
